title: Firewall Configuration Delay
summary: Cloudflare is investigating issues with some firewall configuration updates. Customers making changes to Custom Lists and User Agent Blocking rules, may experience configuration delays applying to the edge. We are working to analyze and mitigate this problem. More updates to follow shortly.
